name: Ancestor Totem, Greater
body:
Ancestor Totem, Greater (Su)
Source Wilderness Origins pg. 24
The barbarian’s insight bonus to her chosen skill increases to +6. Once per rage, she can spend one round of rage as an immediate action to reroll a skill check in the chosen skill. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is lower. A barbarian must have the ancestor totem rage power and be at least 10th level to select this rage power.
